text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today we are going to deal with the writing section.In this period, you will learn about the personal letters in terms of content in the language.You are also expected to write a personal letter about your experience of taking part in a school activity using the correct format and the proper language.Before class, please get your textbook and worksheets ready.In the previous lessons, we have learned that a variety of factors can contribute to happiness.And in our lives, we experience both happy and sad things.So what will you do if you have experienced something happy or sad?Yes, you may want to talk to your best friend or write it down in your diary.So why not write a personal letter to share some important experiences with a friend or a family member?Today we are going to learn about it.Speaking of personal letter, can you guess what the tone of a personal letter is?Is it formal or informal?Right, since it often talks about personal experience, it is obviously an informal letter.On page 16, we have two personal letters from Simon and Li Ping.Would you please first read them and think about these questions?How do Simon and Li Ping start their letters?What does Simon tell Li Ping about his life and what about Li Ping?How do they feel?You will have three minutes for them.Now let's check the answers.As for Simon's letter, he starts with the greeting, how are you?And some questions asking about Li Ping's latest news.Simon tells Li Ping that he is worried about his exam results and he has taken up rock climbing and he really likes it.While in Li Ping's letter, she starts with a response to Simon's experience.She responds that she feels sorry to hear that Simon is worried about exam results and says rock climbing sounds great.Li Ping tells Simon that she has decided to give up competitive tennis.She now gets the support from her parents and has a new social life.So how do they feel?Obviously, Simon feels stressful about the exams but quite excited about rock climbing.Li Ping feels fortunate and relieved when her parents accept the news.But how do you know their feelings?Can you find the evidence in the writing?You will have one minute.In Li Ping's letter, she writes, Fortunately, they took the news very well.From the word fortunately, I know she feels lucky that her parents supported her decision.Great, in both these words, she feels very happy.And in the next one, she writes, I am very happy that her parents are supportive of her decision.In Simon's letter, he writes, I actually really like it.And he uses the exclamation mark.So I know he is quite excited.And I really enjoy the rock climbing.That's right, in both letters we can find expressions like pretty stressed, I actually really like it, and some exclamation marks.These exaggerations can all be used to show one's feelings or attitudes.Do you still remember the tone of a personal letter?Yes, it is informal.So from what words or expressions can you tell these two are informal letters?Yes, they both use hi as a friendly and informal way to address each other.They also use informal words and expressions such as write soon, take care, and love.Before we move on, let's first have a quick review of what we have learned.When we are writing a personal letter about our experience, we should start our letter with asking about the recipient's recent situation and describe the experience in detail, such as our feelings.We should also pay attention to the tone of the personal letter by addressing the recipient properly and use some informal words and expressions.So if you are to work out a checklist for it, what items will you include?You will have the next 30 seconds to think about it.Time's up.当我写一封私人信息时,我会问自己这些问题Is the letter started with asking about the recipient's recent situation?Is the experience described with enough details such as the feelings?Are adverbs and exaggeration used to show attitudes and feelings?Is the recipient properly addressed?Now everybody, it's your turn.Recently, you have taken part in a school activity and you can't wait to share this experience with others.Before writing, think about the recipient of your letter.What kind of school activity you would like to write about and how you felt about it.You will have one minute to think about them.Now you will have the next 6 minutes to write a personal letter with proper language and correct format.Thank you for watching.Thank you for watchingThank you for watchingThank you for watchingThank you check it together.We can add more adverbs and use exclamation marks to express feelings.The experience is described in detail and adverbs and exaggeration are used to express feelings.What about the last one?Yes, she addressed the recipient with Hi.So according to the checklist, we can easily figure out how to improve our letter.Now, this is today's homework.Please polish your writing based on your peer's review.That's all for today.See you next time.
